desc:
NOTICE: Runs best on recent phones, tablets and PCs. On older devices it can run slowly and the car may feel unstable. We’re working on it!
F1 style open-wheel racing on Roblox! Line up on the grid, wait for five red lights and race a full field of rivals in a free single-seater grand prix game.

Box Box Racing is in beta and is receiving frequent updates - expect occasional server shutdowns!

TRACKS: Great Britain, Belgium, Italy, Australia, China, Japan, Miami and Bahrain under the lights.

FEATURES
- Real race weekends: time trial, races with pit stops and tyre strategy
- Changing weather: rain, spray and wet tyres
- 10 teams, custom liveries, helmets and numbers
- Daily challenge and lap time leaderboards
- Multiplayer lobbies with friends (beta)
- Play on PC, controller or phone, with an Easy mode for new drivers

New updates every week. Send feedback from the in-game menu, we read every report.

Formula racing, motorsport, sim racing, car racing, race cars
